fr.recommendations:
• Mark the single access point with a clearly visible address identifier readable from the access road in both directions.

• Post a site map near the access point showing the locations of all three structures, the drive aisle route, and the dumpster enclosure.

• Keep the internal drive aisle clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach all three structures without obstruction.

• Mark the drive aisle path with painted curbing, signage, or pavement markings so responders can navigate to the secondary and detached buildings without prior site knowledge.

• Identify and mark any secondary pedestrian or vehicle path to the rear of the structures, even if limited, so responders are not committed to a single approach route.

• Keep the area around the dumpster enclosure clear so it does not block drive aisle access or force emergency vehicles to reposition.

• Trim vegetation along the access road and drive aisle to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles, including overhead clearance for ladder and aerial apparatus.

• Where dense vegetation limits visibility between structures, mark building corners or exterior walls with reflective identifiers to help responders locate each structure quickly on arrival.

• Identify a staging area near the access point large enough for multiple emergency vehicles that does not block the drive aisle needed to reach rear structures.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin shrubs that are growing close to building walls or entrances.
• Remove dead or dry grass that has accumulated directly against building foundations or along the base of exterior walls.
• Trim lower branches on trees adjacent to buildings to keep them from touching rooflines or exterior walls.
• Thin vegetation growing between buildings to keep it from forming a connected path from one structure to another.
• Keep the large paved areas and open paved surfaces clear of dead leaves, debris, and dried grass that can accumulate along edges and curbs.
• Trim any tree branches that extend over rooftops or gutters.
